title: FMGE Mini Test Series · FMGE Mini Test Series Year 2022 · Fmge Mini Test 18

questions.stem: Which of the following statements is true regarding bladder injury?
questions.stemHtml: Which of the following statements is true regarding bladder injury?

options.label: B
options.text: Intraperitoneal bladder injuries can be managed with catheter drainage for 7-10 days.

options.label: C
options.text: Pelvic urinoma is seen in intraperitoneal rupture.

options.label: D
options.text: A CT cystogram enables the clinical diagnosis for bladder injury and urinary extravasation.
